description: Lists every entity of one Star Wars resource type as a JSON array (Episodes I-VI data). Responses are large (all 82 PEOPLE, about 38 KB); to find a single entity, prefer sw_search, then sw_get; for a compact index pass fields, e.g. ["name"] (about 5 KB).

fields.description: Optional. Field names to keep in each entity (url is always kept), e.g. ["name"] (FILMS: ["title"]). Up to 24 names; an unknown name returns a tool error listing the valid ones. Omit for full entities.

resource.description: Resource type: PEOPLE, FILMS, PLANETS, SPECIES, STARSHIPS or VEHICLES. Any other value returns a tool error.

name: sw_list
